cited_checks.note: The supplied Theorem 4.1 attestation specializes with g=1 to L2 convergence of the truncated uniform empirical-quantile process to the Brownian bridge, exactly as invoked.
The attested Theorem 4 gives N^{-1/(d_Z+2 vee d_Y)} log N when d_Y is not 2; d_Y=1 and d_Z=d yield the stated N^{-1/(d+2)} log N conclusion under the spelled-out source hypotheses.
The attested Theorem 3.1 gives L1 error C L_h n^{-s/(2s+d_Y+d_Z)}; setting s=tau, d_Y=1, d_Z=d, and block size N_n^sm gives the cited block rate.
